mapper.select: SELECT count(member_number) member_number from tbl_member where (member_id = #{memberId} and member_password = #{memberPassword}) and (member_use = 'Y' or member_use = 'V')
select member_number from tbl_member where (member_id = #{memberId} and member_password = #{memberPassword}) and (member_use = 'Y' or member_use = 'V')

select member_number, member_id, member_password, member_name, member_rank, dept_number, team_number, member_use, vacation_count, carryover_count, TO_CHAR(carryover_expire_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as carryover_expire_date, TO_CHAR(employment_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as employment_date, reset_date from tbl_member where member_number = #{sessionNumber}
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_member (member_id, member_password, member_name, member_rank, dept_number, team_number, vacation_count, employment_date, reset_date) values (#{memberId}, #{memberPassword}, #{memberName}, #{memberRank}, #{deptNumber}, #{teamNumber}, #{vacationCount}, #{employmentDate}::date, #{resetDate})
mapper.select: select member_number, vacation_count, carryover_count, TO_CHAR(carryover_expire_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as carryover_expire_date, TO_CHAR(employment_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as employment_date, reset_date from tbl_member where member_use in ('Y', 'V') and employment_date is not null
mapper.update: update tbl_member set carryover_count = '0' where carryover_expire_date is not null and carryover_expire_date < #{today}::date and CAST(carryover_count AS NUMERIC) > 0
